title: Halcyon — a cinematic pro laptop launch
description: A light, cinematic launch page for an invented pro laptop. The pinned hero is a CSS 3D laptop (no WebGL) whose lid opens and screen powers on as you scroll, and which turns when you drag it before swinging back. Then racing render bars, a pausable export, on-device job loaders, a magnifying glass lens over a film frame, a live colour grade driven by scrub fields, a footage offload drop zone, and a size and chip configurator with a rolling price.
features: Scroll-driven CSS 3D laptop: the lid opens on its hinge, the screen powers on and the camera tilts
Drag to turn the laptop; it swings back on a loose spring
Racing render bars and a pausable export progress
Draggable glass lens that magnifies a detailed film frame
Live CSS-filter colour grade driven by scrub fields
Drop zone where footage files become filling chips
Size, chip and finish configurator with a rolling total
No WebGL or model files; reduced-motion aware, hydration-safe, responsive to 390px
